note: Declared recipes for FITOS composite estimates (Phase 7, N2). Each lists the RAW ingredients of ONE serving as USDA FoodData Central records (Foundation 2026-04-30 or SR Legacy 2018-04), the cooking fat as a range, and a widening fraction for recipe-to-recipe variation. The builder computes every number with core composeRecipe(): sum the ingredients, span least-to-most oil, widen, round outward. Spices under ~2 g, salt and water are omitted (negligible energy). Result: source estimated, never verified, confidence medium or low. 'proxy' notes name an ingredient that stands in for one USDA does not have. Beta 3.7 (owner 2026-10-25, ADR-036): every widening is at most 0.10 (it was up to 0.25, which roughly doubled the spread), and an oil range wider than 1.5x is its midpoint +-18 % (a "0 to N g" range is N/2 to N g); each changed recipe's version is bumped. Nine where oil is most of the energy (dry sabzis, fried snacks) have oil at its midpoint +-10 % and widening 0.08, to stay within +-20 %.
